children: SAID ON TUESDAY ITS SUBSIDIARIES SIGN PRELIMINARY AGREEMENT TO SELL TWO LOGISTICS CENTERS TO UNICORN (PL) S.A R.L. FOR ABOUT EUR 110 MLN NET
PRELIMINARY AGREEMENT INCLUDES SALE-AND-LEASEBACK OF LOGISTICS CENTERS IN RZGOW AND KATY WROCLAWSKIE
LEASEBACK AGREEMENTS FOR BOTH LOGISTICS CENTERS ARE TO BE SIGNED FOR A MINIMUM PERIOD OF 15 YEARS
FUNDS FROM THE TRANSACTION WILL BE USED FOR CURRENT OPERATIONS AND FURTHER DEVELOPMENT OF THE GROUP
